attBesluta.text: This foldable rebound board fits in my car nicely. Easy to set up and very portable. It can be used straight or angled the weight means that each time the ball hits the board it doesn't move. The kids loved using it. Its a great added piece of equipment to my coaching kit.

This was exactly what I wanted, it was easy to install, and after a couple of days up the slight wave in it that I thought was due to my installing crookedly disappeared and the fence looks great. I got it to run down the side of my house that slopes down and along the back as it is a garden area and I wanted to keep my three dogs out of that area. It works like a charm, I can easily step over it, but as they have well over an acre they could care less about trying to get through. Mind you, I have a Bassett (short legged), a Corgi (also short legged) and a Welsh Terrier who could jump it if she really wanted to, but doesn't because she can see me if I am in the area. I saw this initially on a different home website, and went directly to Vevor and it was significantly less expensive on their site. Shipping was fast and it was well packaged.
Great quality. Great value. Arrived quickly. Very satisfied
